request.candidates_and_roles: No candidates exist and no working, best-known, or retained role is assigned.
request.cumulative_resource_use: No operations have completed; no training, evaluation, or other campaign resources have been consumed.
request.current_goal_gap: No learned candidate or development measurement exists, so the campaign has no evidence about whether the dominant loss of official success comes from escaping the initially extended singular configuration, selecting a viable elbow trajectory, arriving with residual velocity, or maintaining the complete hold.
request.current_synthesis: The initial physical model makes acquisition and regulation competing consequential explanations. The arm starts fully extended at a singularity, actions are torque commands held for 20 ms, and success is determined by every one of 100 consecutive in-tolerance control observations. A fast policy may improve acquisition while causing overshoot; a policy that reaches the target may still fail the objective through residual motion or boundary crossings. The most credible first direction is to establish a baseline and measure mechanism-specific episode diagnostics rather than optimize a local distance or cumulative-in-tolerance proxy.
request.decision_frontier: After the first baseline training and diagnostic evaluation, compare first-entry timing, entry velocity or convergence quality, longest uninterrupted hold, interruption counts, and target-radius/angle strata. If failures occur before reliable entry, investigate acquisition and branch/trajectory selection; if entry is common but 100-step holds fail, investigate regulation and velocity shaping; if geometry stratifies failures, focus the next intervention on the limiting basin or configuration.
request.human_goal_connection: The human goal requires at least 196 of 200 official episodes to complete one uninterrupted 100-step hold. The first scientific direction must therefore distinguish failures of reaching and trajectory selection from failures of low-velocity convergence and sustained regulation before choosing a policy or reward intervention.
request.next_direction_or_closure: At goal review, open an inquiry centered on discriminating acquisition/trajectory failure from convergence/regulation failure, then perform one baseline training operation and one diagnostic research evaluation under the official target distribution.
